stemMd: Which EU institution is directly elected by EU citizens?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The Court of Justice of the EU

explanationMd: Citizens elect Members of the European Parliament. This gives Parliament a direct representative role in EU law-making and scrutiny. The other listed institutions have different appointment processes.

distractorRationale.d: Commissioners are not elected directly in an EU-wide public vote.
distractorRationale.b: Judges are not directly elected by citizens.
distractorRationale.e: Its members are not chosen through a direct popular election.
